summary: Complete testing of SAAD-Guardian link features. All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified SAAD company-agency page with 2 tabs (Agences + Gardiens), guardian invite popup, relationship chips (professional green, personal white), and SAAD affiliation card on guardian dashboard.

backend_api_tests.GET /api/company/guardians: PASS - Returns list of linked guardians with statuses

POST /api/company/invite-guardian.unknown_phone: PASS - Returns sms_sent status for unknown numbers

backend_api_tests.GET /api/guardian/saad-link: PASS - Returns null or SAAD affiliation object

SAAD_company_agency_page.agencies_tab: PASS - Shows list of agencies with intervenant counts
SAAD_company_agency_page.gardiens_tab: PASS - Shows linked guardians with status badges (SMS envoye, Rattache)
SAAD_company_agency_page.add_guardian_button: PASS - 'Ajouter un gardien' button opens popup
SAAD_company_agency_page.add_guardian_popup: PASS - Phone input field visible, 'Envoyer l'invitation' button works

guardian_dashboard_saad_card.affiliation_card: PASS - Green card shows 'SAAD Aide a Domicile' with RATTACHE badge
guardian_dashboard_saad_card.company_address: PASS - Shows '15 avenue de la Gare, 42000 Saint-Etienne'

relationship_chips_popup.professional_group: PASS - Green label 'PROFESSIONNEL' with chips: Auxiliaire de vie, Aide soignant(e), Aide à domicile, Professionnel de santé
relationship_chips_popup.personal_group: PASS - White label 'PERSONNEL / FAMILIAL' with chips: Mère, Père, Fils, Fille, Conjoint(e), Frère, Sœur, Voisin(e), Autre
relationship_chips_popup.chip_styling: PASS - Professional chips show green when selected, personal chips show white/light

mocked_apis.SMS_sending: SIMULATED - SMS invitations logged via logger, not sent via Twilio

seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo users. Ludivine has accepted SAAD invitation during testing.
